description: Search the DietCamera calorie dictionary (50,000+ Korean dishes, Korean franchise menus and packaged foods) by name. Use it when the user asks for the calories or nutrition of a food and you need to find matching items. Returns up to 20 items, each with serving size, kcal per serving and per 100 g/ml, carbohydrate, protein, fat, sugars, sodium, an "AI 추정치, 참고용" (AI estimate) flag when values are estimated, and the URL of the source page. Names are matched in Korean, e.g. "김치찌개", "스타벅스 라떼", "불닭볶음면".

kind.description: Limit to one type: food = general dishes, franchise = restaurant/cafe chain menus, processed = packaged foods

query.description: Food name in Korean, optionally with the brand, e.g. "교촌 허니콤보", "김치찌개"

name: search_food
title: Search Korean food calories
